svg.title: The pods of ate-system on kind-control-plane
svg.desc: An isometric drawing of the namespace ate-system as one floor tile on the node kind-control-plane, which carries the Kubernetes mark. The tile holds 11 running pods and 1 finished Job, one object for each pod. Two ate-api-server towers and two ate-idp-server towers stand side by side, and one ate-controller tower stands alone, all with the Agent Substrate mark. postgres-0 is a cylinder and rustfs is a bucket. atenet-router and atenet-egress are gateway units with the Envoy mark. atelet and k8s-credential-provider are small units, and the finished Job rustfs-bucket-init is a dashed outline.
